bullets.title: KONG Wubba
bullets.note:
\-- More specifically, [my pup
Molly](http://www.fourhournewsletter.com/click.html?x=a62e&lc=wCs&mc=e&s=bomwH&u=w&y=R&)
is loving this. She has methodically destroyed every “indestructible” dog toy
I’ve given her, except this and perhaps 1-2 others. It’s also easy to throw
long distances without getting your hands slobbered. The only (potential)
downside: an incredibly loud squeaker. If it starts to bother me, I just
imagine what a particularly serious friend’s face would look like if Molly
were chomping the Wubba as he tried to finish the last bit of a crossword
puzzle. That enough to make me laugh at the racket.

bullets.title: Good lord
bullets.note:
,
I'm still working on two hands on the floor!
